remarks: Beautifully situated 4-bedroom, 4.5-bath New Canaan home tucked away on nearly 5 acres of wilderness bordering Grupes Reservoir. The home has a welcoming, gracious flow from the entryway to the expansive, vaulted-ceiling great room. Windows to nature, a breakfast bar, top-of-the-line appliances, and custom cabinetry are just a few attributes that make this home so enjoyable. The large wet bar/butler's pantry is perfectly situated for entertaining. The second floor boasts 4 sizable bedrooms, two of which are en-suite, an alcove home office/play area, and a shared bathroom. There is a full bath with a shower stall in the mudroom which is perfect for leaving the outdoors at the door. The added feature of this home is a large, light-filled family room/office. The property is nestled in the woods so you can enjoy the pool in complete privacy, hike the nature trails to the reservoir, watch the seasons change from the expansive patios and terraces, and enjoy all that this nature lover's paradise has to offer. Tenant pays for opening/closing of pool and weekly cleaning costs.
